newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong cash rates, govt paper yields steady.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong cash rates, govt paper yields steady.

text.p: Hong Kong interbank cash rates and Exchange Fund paper yields were stagnant in quiet trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
Interbank overnight cash rates stood at 5-1/4 3/16 percent versus 5-1/4 1/8 at Tuesday's midsession.
Three-month term money traded at 5-7/16 3/8 percent versus 5-7/16 5/16 percent.
The yield on one-week Exchange Fund bills was unchanged at 4.7 percent. Yields of three-year notes also stayed flat at 5.88 percent.
Five-year notes yielded 6.30 percent versus 6.29, and seven-year notes yielded 6.56 percent versus 6.54.
Yields of the longest 10-year Exchange Fund notes traded at 6.78 percent versus 6.77.
